title: Chapter 379: Punishment
content:
Chapter 379: Punishment

When the last node moved in with the dojo staff, a sky-penetrating light appeared, like a pillar of heaven, connecting the sky and the earth.

These visions covered the eight kingdoms of the Kanto region, and the dazzling 81 pillars of light could be seen anywhere in the world.

This is the Jiuhe Yuan Mie Yuan Formation.

This formation is not clever, it is just a simple superposition of power, plus some negative factors such as confusion, weakening, and curse.

Now that Zhong Yu has arranged it, another layer of change has been added to it, adding the attribute of ghost.

If some ordinary people arrange this kind of formation, because their personal strength is limited, their abilities are weak, and there are very few forces and resources that can be mobilized, even if they are deployed, the power will not be very great.

But if it were replaced by the master of such a powerful force as Zhong Yu, the Eight Kingdoms would be used by him in one word, and a steady stream of manpower and material resources would be mobilized, plus the army obtained by sacrificing the Eight Kingdoms, the power of this arrangement can be said to be sky-high.

This is a kind of formation that the more investment, the greater the power. The most obvious feature is simplicity, so simple that it can be arranged with a little knowledge of formations.

It's not that Zhong Yu doesn't have other more subtle and powerful formations.

However, the current situation is pressing.

It takes countless time to prepare for the exquisite formation to be arranged, and the right time, place and people are indispensable.

Among them, we must pay more attention to every detail. If there is a slight problem in any link, it will deal a huge blow to the entire formation. Although it will not be completely destroyed, its power will be greatly reduced.

And this and so on. For today's Zhong Yu, that is tantamount to useless.

He was pressed for time, he only had two hours, and there was no time to prepare such an exquisite formation.

Opportunities on the battlefield are changing rapidly, and the details are difficult to control. What is pursued is a general direction of control.

The subtle requirements of an exquisite formation are undoubtedly impossible for a rapidly changing war.

Therefore, for an army that is pressed for time, the simpler and more brutal formation is the most suitable.

The attention of the heavens and the earth not only attracted the attention of the people of the world, but also the gods of Gaotianyuan, who lived high in reality and illusion, were also attracted.

"This is? Damn, this shameless person who doesn't keep his promise and doesn't have the slightest reputation." Amaterasu yelled angrily. Above the airspace of the Eight Kingdoms, the largest face covering tens of miles, as the dark clouds gathered, show up.

At the same time, the other four demigods around it also condensed their will and turned their attention to the formation that appeared in the Eight Kingdoms.

Looking around, I saw endless black and red clouds surging within the formation, covering thousands of miles of land in the Eight Kingdoms, making such a vast area completely plunged into a black and red mist.

And within the cloud where you can't see your fingers, the only thing you can see is the 81 pillars of heaven that are shining with infinite brilliance.

With a thought, Amaterasu gathered infinite brilliance from the high-altitude scorching sun, turned it into a dazzling lightsaber, slashed downward, and scattered the clouds and mist in a radius of tens of miles.

But before he was happy, the surrounding clouds and mist entangled again, covering the mist that had just been dispelled once again, turning into black and red clouds again, covering the entire area, making people unaware of the truth.

"It seems that this is an extremely difficult and deceptive formation with strong repairing power. Unless the entire formation can be broken in one fell swoop, or because the formation bases distributed everywhere, that is, the 81 heavenly Pillars are needed to clean up an area. Otherwise, if you enter rashly, you may be in danger of getting lost."

After experimenting, Amaterasu said slowly.

"Then Your Highness can find a solution. If this formation is not removed, there will be no majesty left."

As one of the three noble gods, Yueyomi Ming is also the witness and supervisor of the last contract. At this moment, in order to punish the person who violated the covenant, he also followed.

"I can't either, you saw it just now, I condensed the most powerful power in my previous life and summoned the power of fierce flames, but I could only disperse the thick fog in a range of dozens of miles, but I was powerless.

But looking at the area of the formation, it has already covered thousands of miles. With my strength, I may not be able to dispel these fogs even after exhausting all my divine power. "

God Amaterasu smiled wryly, shook his head, and said such a fact dryly.

"Should we just let it go like this? How about joining forces? Gathering the strength of five people, how can we block it with just one formation!"

The grumpy Susanoo let out a roar, like a wolf like a tiger, thunderous and majestic, and proposed a plan of joint attack.

"I'm afraid it won't work. Although the power of the five of us has greatly increased, it may be very difficult to dispel the fog.

I observed carefully just now, this formation is based on the leylines within the eight countries, and by extracting the power from the leylines, it serves as the foundation for maintaining the formation.

If we work together, although we are powerful, we may still be insufficient in the face of the power of the Eight Kingdoms. "

God Amaterasu immediately opposed this proposal, although they are the gods who hold authority, in this world, after thousands of years of common anger, they have already grasped the righteousness.

But after all, this kind of status is only based on human beings. Compared with the whole world, it has some effects, but it is not important, and it is not crucial.

However, the power of the gods to hold power comes from the heaven and the earth. If Xiang wants to fight against the heaven and the earth, then it is worth considering who this power will help, and which is stronger or weaker.

The power of the earth veins in the eight countries is gathered, and this power is incredible, if it can be used and released by people. It is very difficult to completely destroy and kill the five demigods, but once they are completely injured and repelled, it can still be done.

"Wait first! Although we have signed a contract, we have the responsibility to deal with this violator. But don't forget, the supervisory function is not only the five of us, but also the will of heaven and earth, as well as our Father God and Mother God. "

God Amaterasu smiled strangely, but he was not in a hurry to attack immediately, but turned his mind to other aspects.

The other people were also taken aback when they heard the words, and then they all reacted with smiles.

That's right, when I signed the contract, I expected that I and others might not be able to defeat and kill this defaulter.

Therefore, Father God and Mother God, as well as the will of heaven and earth, are specifically mentioned above the witnesses, and they are invited to witness and supervise.

If it is an ordinary mortal, even if they openly insult the world and the gods in broad daylight, there is no great power to pay attention to it.

After all, who would care about the words of an ant, there is no need, the two sides are not at the same level at all.

But if these people are replaced by high gods, who have mastered the authority of heaven and earth, they have entered the consciousness of heaven and earth early, and in the eyes of the two supreme gods, they have considerable weight in their hearts and have been paid attention to for a long time.

The enforcement and fairness of this contract will be greatly strengthened.

The price to be paid for violating this and other powerful supervision contracts is absolutely incomparably heavy, and there is not even enough strength to resist punishment, and it is impossible to escape death.

Sure enough, not long after, while the five gods were discussing, the manifested vision that belonged exclusively to the consciousness of heaven, the purple eye of thunder and punishment, suddenly appeared in the air.
